ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 85% of the visible surface, contrasted sharply with low-intensity black pixels localized along the perimeter and in discrete focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Surface is primarily high-intensity white. A continuous black band follows the trailing and lateral edges. Specific dark geometric blobs: one medium circular spot in the lower-central region of the right lobe; two small contiguous spots on the distal right lobe; one small spot on the lower-inner left lobe; and a cluster of irregular dark pixels at the base of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a measured acute angle of approximately 65 degrees and a significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration characterized by multiple peaks and valleys (amplitudes ranging 5-15 pixels) across the continuous trailing edge; highest density of serration is located on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve originating from the median notch and sweeping outward and upward towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast, raised, circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Distinct white circular ring scars are visible on the upper-distal region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both lateral tips; multiple circular depigmented 'cookie-cutter' style ring scars on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible yellowish-tan pixel gradient (likely diatom film) concentrated on the lower horizontal half of the white ventral surface on both lobes.
